watchlist.response: Management did not quantify the potential deflation, instead focusing on efficiency saves funding investments.
watchlist.text: AI-led productivity deflation could pressure existing business revenue.

watchlist.response: Management said the impact was about 1-1.5% of Q1 revenue and called it an isolated, one-off instance due to a client leadership change; the client continues to expand with Firstsource.
watchlist.text: Impact of healthcare BPaaS program termination on Q1 revenue and whether it signals broader healthcare churn.

watchlist.response: Management said it was a one-time settlement of a commercial dispute from a prior-period claims processing issue, since remediated, and is pursuing insurance recovery.
watchlist.text: Whether the ₹28.4 Cr regulatory penalty indemnity reflects a systemic issue in outcome-based delivery.

watchlist.response: Management attributed it to cost of growth during client ramps in a particular quarter and pointed to seven straight quarters of company-level margin expansion.
watchlist.text: Segment margin divergence versus FY24, particularly healthcare falling to low double digits.
